decisions.reason: The Black Edition extends the firm's established design range with low incremental cost, fits the black-bathroom trend and gained its own web page in 2024, which signals continued commitment.
CeraFrame Liquid serves the growing market for seamless, barrier-free bathrooms, sits close to the core shower channel line and has been featured consistently on its own page.

The pump-drain shower channel was launched only in 2024 and appears to replace the earlier pump-assisted solution, giving the firm a future-ready answer for renovations where gravity drainage is not possible, so it needs time to establish itself.
